tool_args.rationale: The failed four-parameter barrier law and added rows establish a pronounced gradient effect while preserving a monotone-concave response in u. Fit the simpler node-C inland-hub law with its positive square-root branch numerically to all ten rows and let fresh confirmation decide whether it meets tolerance.

considered_alternatives.option: Acquire another probe (slow-horizon or fine trajectory)
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All ten measurements are at H=0.6, but the observed failure is most consistent with a wrong static response family; additional trajectory data is less directly informative than refitting the gradient-dependent static law.
Its four-parameter fit was already refuted on fresh confirmation, with confirm RMSE 0.29006 versus tolerance 0.045.

Possible sink-dependent alternative, but outputs are monotone-concave across u and the simpler inland-hub saturating base with an open positive square-root branch matches the signatures and uses fewer parameters.
No high-frequency chaotic sign oscillation is present; the stationary gradient-dependent measurements provide an interpretable candidate family.
